Name: Raymond Jakubauskas; Carola Frehe
Source: Wikipedia: List of fatal bear attacks in North America
Notes: Black bear broke the necks of both victims while they were setting up camp; the bear then dragged the bodies into the woods. Outside the 15-20 year target window -- kept as a well-documented reference case.

Name: Jacqueline Perry
Source: Wikipedia: List of fatal bear attacks in North America
Notes: Killed in an attack at a remote campsite; her husband was seriously injured defending her and later received a Star of Courage. MNR staff shot and killed the bear.
